#### What type of PR is this?

<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->
/kind flake
#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Once the node gets deleted, the nodelifecycle controller
is racing to update pod status and the pod deletion logic
is failing causing tests to flake. This commit moves
the testContext creation to within the test loop and deletes nodes,
namespace within the test loop. We don't explicitly call the node
deletion within the loop but the `testutils.CleanupTest(t, testCtx)`
call ensures that the namespace, nodes gets deleted.
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->
Fixes #105492

-->

NONE

- [Other doc]: <link>

issue_context.title: PreferNominatedNode integration test flakes
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting reports about flaky tests or jobs (pass or fail with no underlying change in code) in Kubernetes CI -->

#### Which jobs are flaking:
Integration tests are sometimes flaking locally:

https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/105432/pull-kubernetes-integration/1445055277958172672
#### Which test(s) are flaking:
PreferNominatedNode
#### Testgrid link:

#### Reason for failure:
Once the node gets deleted, the nodelifecycle controller
is racing to update pod status and the pod deletion logic
is failing causing tests to flake.

Ultimately, we call testCtx.CleanUp() which cleans
the nodes and the pods involved the test namespace so
we are not going to leak any resources.

#### Anything else we need to know:
- links to go.k8s.io/triage appreciated
- links to specific failures in spyglass appreciated

#### Relevant SIG
<!-- You can identify the SIG from the "prowjob_config_url" on the testgrid dashboard for a test -->
/sig scheduling

<!-- Please see the deflaking doc (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-testing/flaky-tests.md) for more guidance! -->

/assign @chendave

review_comments: It doesn't look like this change was necessary, was it?
Wei wanted nodeConfig struct to be removed, so I came up with this change.

Sounds good
/lgtm
Leaving approval to Wei
I think it's more conventional to use a param to specify the count of nodes, and then compose `node-%v` as the node name.

TBH, the struct was copied from other testcases, e.g. `TestPDBInPreemption`. I am good with remove this struct, but shall we remove others as well? besides, this change sound like a good candidate for cherry-pick, a pure fixing and a separate  refactoring looks better to me.
I agree that a pure fix would be better.

@Huang-Wei - I want the node name to be statically available during static test case declaration, [for example](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105509/files#diff-efced158b524dbfdeb8a07abf3c8b122dd37d5eefa9301b09477c05794cc9ea6L1409). So, it needs some refactoring and I am wondering if you see an advantage with the approach you suggested.

@chendave - Yes, we can remove the struct in a separate PR. However I may not have cycles in the next few weeks to work on refactors. But I can create an issue and perhaps this is a good `first-timer` issue?

@ravisantoshgudimetla let's keep the current style then.

And yes, we can do a refactoring in a follow-up.
yeah, this line is a real culprit, thanks for fixing this issue.
